native_observation: Go os.File.Sync on the named FIFO returns nil on this Darwin host. The assumption that all FIFOs refuse synchronization was false; anonymous pipe behavior does not establish named FIFO behavior.
production_correction: Removed the proposed file-kind gate and redundant Stat. Go decides whether an acquired entry synchronizes. On native Sync failure after Chmod, return indeterminate activation with its cause.
test_correction: Probe Sync through an independently opened read-only nonblocking Go handle; expect the actual host result and preserve mode effects, inode and caller handle.
